# DeCovarT reproducibility

Companion analysis repository for the
[DeCovarT](https://bastienchassagnol.github.io/DeCovarT/) package.
Scripts estimate cell-type means and sparse precisions from the
Suppinger gastruloid single-cell resource, lift them to the population
Gaussian that DeCovarT convolves, and benchmark the resulting bulk
deconvolution. The narrative lives in the Quarto book under `docs/`.

All datasets are freely available via GEO. If you use the method in
your own work, please cite the package and this repository.

## Generative model

DeCovarT treats a bulk profile as a Gaussian convolution of latent
cell-type profiles. Proportions lie on the simplex. Each type has its
own mean and covariance; the precision is the sparse object estimated
in this repository.

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| label: fig-readme-generative
%%| fig-cap: "DeCovarT generative model. Cell-type profiles are Gaussian. Bulk observations are their mixture."
%%{init: {"theme": "sandstone", "flowchart": {"curve": "basis"}}}%%
flowchart TB
  subgraph plateJ["j = 1, ..., J"]
    direction TB
    mu["mu_j"] --> xj(("x_j"))
    Sj["Sigma_j"] --> xj
  end
  subgraph plateI["i = 1, ..., N"]
    direction TB
    p["p_i on the simplex"] --> y(["y_i"])
  end
  xj -.->|"y_i = mu p_i"| y
  classDef param fill:#ffffff,stroke:#0f172a,stroke-width:1.5px
  classDef latent fill:#ffffff,stroke:#0f172a,stroke-width:1.5px
  classDef obs fill:#cbd5e1,stroke:#0f172a,stroke-width:1.5px
  class mu,Sj param
  class xj,p latent
  class y obs
```

The book compares three ways to estimate $\Sigma_j^{-1}$ from labelled
cells (`huge`, `SILGGM` after a nonparanormal map, and `PLNnetwork`),
two lifts to the population Gaussian, and an optional stricter gene
panel.

## How to render the Quarto book

From the repository root, after `renv::restore()`:

```bash
quarto render docs
# first time only, once gh-pages is allowed:
# quarto publish gh-pages docs
```

The book format is **HTML only** for now (`pdf` is commented in
`docs/_quarto.yml`). CI publishes HTML to the `gh-pages` branch.

R chunks in `docs/` stay `eval: false` until artefacts exist. Mermaid
and static Markdown still execute;
[`freeze: auto`](https://quarto.org/docs/projects/code-execution.html#freeze)
caches those results in `docs/_freeze`.

This `README.md` is rendered from `README.qmd`. Do not edit
`README.md` by hand.
